label: RESEARCH_ONLY forward test. No orders, no recommendations, no pushes. Hypothetical taker entries only.
question: On 2026-27 games (season 2027) unseen by both models' fits, does the frozen candidate C2 (incumbent margin + certified SIFT CBB inputs) price Kalshi full-game margin contracts better than the incumbent pure-0.2.0 under the same frozen selection rules, and is its margin more accurate?
frozen_before: This file and its sha256 (protocol.sha256) are written before any 2026-27 outcome (ESPN final score, Kalshi result/settlement) is joined to any projection, feature or quote. run.py stage 'score' refuses to run if the hash does not match.

candidate.name: C2 (margin)
candidate.source: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/15192055-9b55-53ba-8bb5-ba530026a7da/scratchpad/cbb_pred/report.json -> candidates.margin.C2 (OLS fit on seasons 2016-2022 only); NOT refit

columns.inc_margin: incumbent pure-0.2.0 published projection.margin, home minus away in ESPN listed orientation (the projection used is the incumbent row defined below)
columns.d_mx_<x>: mx_<x>(home row) - mx_<x>(away row) for x in efg_pre, tov_pct_pre, orb_pct_pre, ftr100_pre
columns.rows: certified team rows keyed (ESPN game_id, ESPN team id); home row = ESPN schedule home_id, away row = away_id (ESPN listed orientation, also for neutral sites), each team's own row only, exactly as cbb_pred/run.py build_dataset

candidate.sigma_source: cbb_pred report.json calibration.margin.candidate_sd_from_validation = SD (ddof=1) of C2 residuals on validation seasons 2023-2024 only; recorded here before any 2026-27 outcome is touched

incumbent.source: cbb-edge-finder branch projections-archive (commit 1929f14396736a405c0ea673d1a964ec3132b960), files projections/2027/<date>/G<espn_game_id>/<as_of>.json; schema sift-cbb-projection-1.0
incumbent.row_rule: per game, the record with the latest prospective.as_of <= cutoff, where cutoff = the game's Kalshi entry snapshot captured_at if the game has one, else listed tip-off - 30 min. Games with no such record are dropped (counted).
incumbent.orientation: record home/away team_id (canonical) compared with canonical_from_espn(ESPN home_id/away_id); if swapped, margin sign is flipped; if neither matches, the game is dropped (counted)
incumbent.sigma: projection.margin_sd (the incumbent's own published SD = arms.residual_sd bucketed by games seen, used by pure.finalize and by its own spread_cover_prob_fn Phi((margin - line)/margin_sd))
incumbent.walk_forward_reproduction: scripts/research/run_wave2.py hard-codes SEASONS 2006-2026 and needs stats.ncaa.org lineup/possession files that do not exist for 2027, so the reproduced walk-forward cannot produce 2026-27 projections without modification; only the archived prospective records are used (no agreement comparison possible).

certified_features.engine: sift-alpha-ops (HEAD 84c2a724c0038ac376e9047484668c6099e1c5a3) alpha_engine.derived.basketball.build(root, 'CBB') unmodified, root = vault archives/CBB/espn_team_box_schedules/2006-2027/sportsdataverse/snapshot-20261116 restored into WORK/vault
certified_features.file: WORK/feat/cbb_derived_team.parquet (recomputed in WORK); its season-2027 rows are compared with cbb_pred/feat/cbb_derived_team.parquet and any difference is reported

games.universe: ESPN schedule season 2027 (vault snapshot-20261116) games with listed-start ET date 2026-11-03 through 2026-11-15 inclusive, STATUS_FINAL in that snapshot, with an incumbent row (above) and complete certified features for both teams (all 7 C2 inputs finite).
games.window_limit: 2026-11-15 is the last ET date in the vault ESPN snapshot-20261116, which is the only source of certified 2026-27 features and ESPN final scores; later games have no certified features and are out of scope (reported, not substituted).
games.tip_off: ESPN schedule field `date` (UTC listed start time)

quotes.timestamp_field: record captured_at (UTC; equals the file-name stamp). Asserted < tip-off for every entry.
quotes.other_families: KXNCAAMBTOTAL/TEAMTOTAL are not functions of margin; half/OT/race series are not full-game margin functions; excluded
quotes.mapping: event -> ESPN game via the incumbent's cbb_edge.kalshi.mapping.map_market (exact keys only, fail closed) against the ESPN 2027 schedule with canonical team ids; unmapped events counted
quotes.semantics: cbb_edge.kalshi.semantics.parse_contract (WINNER: subject wins; SPREAD: subject wins by more than floor_strike, strike_type 'greater', text strike must equal floor_strike); only status 'parsed' contracts kept. P(YES) for subject=home: P(M > k); subject=away: P(M < -k); winner k = 0.
quotes.entry: game-level entry snapshot = the latest archive snapshot with captured_at <= tip_off - 30 min. Contracts = that game's GAME/SPREAD markets in that snapshot with status 'active' and a two-sided quote 0 < yes_bid < yes_ask < 1 (dollars). yes_bid = yes_bid_dollars, yes_ask = yes_ask_dollars, size_yes_ask = yes_ask_size_fp, size_yes_bid = yes_bid_size_fp.
quotes.close_for_clv: the latest snapshot with entry captured_at < captured_at < tip_off in which the same ticker is active with a two-sided quote; otherwise no CLV for that contract
quotes.staleness: no cap; distribution of tip_off - entry captured_at is reported

settlement.primary: Kalshi official results, sift-data-vault archives/CBB/kalshi_official_settlements/all-to-20261116/kalshi_public_api/snapshot-20261116 (restored with tools/vault.py), result in {yes,no}
settlement.fallback: for tickers absent from that archive: Kalshi market `result` (status finalized/settled) in the most recent kalshi-archive snapshot containing the ticker; source recorded per contract
settlement.excluded: contracts with no yes/no official result (counted)
settlement.semantics_check: for every settled contract, settle(parse, ESPN final home/away score) vs Kalshi result; agreement reported; any disagreeing contract is excluded and listed

evaluation.module: copy of sift-alpha-ops alpha_engine/pipeline/selection.py + sift_clv/canonical.py in WORK/sift, evaluate(contracts, rules, boot=2000, seed=7)
evaluation.same_contracts: C2 and incumbent are scored on the identical contract table (same quotes, same y); only model_p differs
evaluation.reported_per_rule: bets, win rate vs fee-adjusted break-even, net ROI with game-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (seed 7, 2000), size-capped min(10, displayed size) P&L, price buckets, by family, by side, selection CLV where a later pre-tip snapshot exists
evaluation.diagnostics: Brier / log loss of model vs entry mid on every contract (diagnostic only), also per family
evaluation.overlap: number of bets both models select (same ticker and side) per rule

outcome_only.metrics: margin RMSE, MAE, bias (actual - pred) for incumbent and C2; winner accuracy
outcome_only.paired: d = (y - C2)^2 - (y - inc)^2 per game; mean with 95% percentile bootstrap CI over games (2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(seed=7)); also date-clustered as a secondary CI. Negative = C2 better.
outcome_only.calibration: PIT coverage of 50% / 80% central Normal intervals for each model's own sigma

decision: No promotion or betting decision is made from this sample. A tiny sample is reported as tiny; CIs are the primary read.
amendments: recorded separately (protocol_amendments.json); this file is never edited after its sha256 is written
